$comment: Which platform commit this repo is synced to (Arch A2, R160). On the platform itself the commit is null: it IS the
platform, and the downstream gate (PlatformFiles_MatchTheStampedManifest_OrAreAllowlisted) does not apply here.
Downstream, tools/port-platform.ps1 writes this file together with tests/Api.Tests/App/platform-manifest.json: the
commit the files were merged from, the date, and the brand map the gate uses to compare a renamed file with the
platform's (platform token -> this repo's token). /api/version reports the commit as `platform`.
